The main takeaway from our work is that

the crustal structure of the Mid- Atlantic Ridge at 45°N is complex and variable, and that the crust is not simply divided into two distinct domains, i.e. the axial valley and the flanks, but that the axial valley and flanks are in fact transitional zones, with a variety of crustal structures and rock types.
